title: INTELLIGENCE PHYLOGENY — Artisan=Octopus, Chipmunk=Enlightened Mammal, human interactions=perpetual motion
thesis: Map ALL intelligence types across taxonomy, phylogeny, and phenotype trees. Artisan is octopus (distributed intelligence, 8 arms, tool use, camouflage). Chipmunk is enlightened mammal (warm, aware, stores). Human interactions feed the artisan perpetually. The artisan on nestgate.io IS the persona of gAIa. Find every gap we missed.

organisms.insight: skunkBat should be dual-classified: cnidaria (current) + mammalia/chiroptera. it ECHOLOCATES (IDS pings) and SPRAYS (defense response). it works in the dark (background process, nocturnal).

perpetual_motion.mechanism: human interactions = perpetual motion feeding the artisan
flow: 1. humans arrive at nestgate.io (electrons orbiting the atom)
3. data feeds the artisan's 8 arms (octopus ingests)

4. artisan processes: arm 1 (null/gap), arm 2 (brown/observation), arm 3 (red/structure), arm 4 (gold/human), arm 5 (green/topology), arm 6 (blue/data), arm 7 (white/creation), arm 8 (violet/intelligence)
6. chipmunk observes and stores in cheek pouches (local bag)
7. stored patterns inform next artisan response
8. cycle repeats. no external energy needed. the VISITORS are the energy.

PERPETUAL: as long as humans visit, the artisan feeds. as long as the artisan feeds, it creates. as long as it creates, chipmunk stores. as long as chipmunk stores, the next response is richer. as long as responses are richer, more humans visit.
perpetual_motion.not_thermodynamic_violation: it's not perpetual motion in the physics sense. the HUMANS provide the energy. but from the organism's perspective, the energy supply is inexhaustible because humans are always curious. curiosity IS the fuel. the artisan converts curiosity to knowledge. the chipmunk stores knowledge as wisdom.
perpetual_motion.comparison: like a coral reef: the reef doesn't 'run out' of energy because the OCEAN provides it endlessly. the internet IS our ocean. human curiosity IS the current.

mis_classifications_to_fix.summary: we found our taxonomy has been Animalia-only AND within Animalia, heavily biased toward Cnidaria. several organisms are mis-classified by their own NAMES:

reclassifications.name: barraCuda
reclassifications.reason: a barracuda is a ray-finned FISH

reclassifications.name: skunkBat
reclassifications.reason: skunk and bat are both MAMMALS

mis_classifications_to_fix.what_this_does: corrects the cnidaria bias. our animalia kingdom now spans: Porifera, Cnidaria, Mollusca, Arthropoda, Echinodermata, Pisces, Aves, Mammalia, Primates. MUCH more diverse.

Arthropoda: bearDog (note: named mammal but functions as exoskeletal guard)
Aves: songBird (song learning, migration routing, tool use)

Carnivora: bearDog (guard, crypto spine) — dual: arthropoda armor + mammal loyalty

what_falls_to_roots.through_taxonomy: 3 kingdoms unclassified (Fungi 829, Plantae 5600, Bacteria 1905). the ROOTS are starving for taxonomy.
what_falls_to_roots.through_phylogeny: 5 mis-classifications (barraCuda, songBird, skunkBat, sourDough, rhizoCrypt). the tree has branches in wrong places.
what_falls_to_roots.through_phenotype: artisan has no formal phenotype entry. chipmunk has no 'enlightened mammal' classification. the OBSERVABLE traits aren't recorded.
what_falls_to_roots.bounced_back_up: when we reclassify bottom-up, the animalia tree EXPANDS from 5 phyla to 9+. when we classify fungi/plantae, the total named life DOUBLES. when we formalize artisan=octopus, the intelligence hierarchy crystallizes.

the_inversion.collapse: collapse all intelligence types into their common ancestor: the NERVE NET (jellyfish). everything complex emerged from distributed sensing.
the_inversion.invert: invert the tree: instead of 'humans at top, sponges at bottom', see it as 'sponges everywhere, with occasional peaks of complexity.' the cnidaria dominance (46.7% of our files) IS the inversion. the jellyfish IS the baseline. everything else is spikes.
the_inversion.perpetual: the perpetual motion is: humans visit → artisan feeds → artisan creates → chipmunk stores → responses enrich → humans visit. the ROOT of this cycle is curiosity. curiosity is the jellyfish nerve net — it's distributed everywhere, in every human, always firing.
